user.title: DomoTwin
user.description: Add DomoTwin, your home as a live 3D twin. You will import your plan from the DomoTwin panel in the sidebar.

data_description.sidebar: The full-screen view with the editor. Dashboard cards work either way.
data_description.sidebar_admin_only: Other users can still use DomoTwin cards on dashboards.

show.name: Show
show.description: Shows a room, an element, a storey or a view on the DomoTwin screens (cards and panel), or on one of them.

room.name: Room
room.description: A room of the plan, by its name or its id (on any storey).

element.name: Element
element.description: Any element of the plan, by its name or its id: it is framed.

storey.name: Storey
storey.description: A storey, by its name, its id or its number (0 for the ground floor, 1 above, -1 below); all for every storey at once.

view.name: View
view.description: overview, 3d, 2d, walk (at eye level, to the room given), or the name of a saved viewpoint.

person.name: Person
person.description: A person DomoTwin places (person.…): their room is shown, if they are at home in a room known.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The screen to show it on: a card's screen option. Empty for every screen.

where.name: Where
where.description: Where a person is, or a device DomoTwin follows by Bluetooth, or everyone at home: their room, and a sentence to answer with (in Home Assistant's language).

name.name: Name
name.description: A person's name, or a followed device's ("my keys"), as said (a first name is enough, a letter off is forgiven). Empty for everyone at home.

show.name: Show
show.description: Also show their room on the DomoTwin screens.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The screen to show it on: a card's screen option. Empty for every screen.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Switches devices on or off later, at a time or after a delay, and on again until a time or for a while: kept by DomoTwin, even across restarts. Answers what was set, with a sentence to say.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: What to switch: lights, switches, fans, media players, climate, covers (opened and closed)…

action.name: Action
action.description: on to switch on (open a cover), off to switch off (close it).

at.name: At
at.description: When: a date and time (Home Assistant's time zone unless one is given), or a time of day for the next one. Or give a delay.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: When, from now: instead of at.

until.name: Until
until.description: With on: when to switch off again, a date and time or a time of day (the next one after the start).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: With on: how long to leave it on, instead of until.

unschedule.name: Unschedule
unschedule.description: Cancels actions set with domotwin.schedule: one by its id, or all those of some entities. A device already switched on stays on.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Every action waiting on these entities.

schedule_no_entities.message: Name at least one entity to switch.

schedule_too_many_entities.message: At most 10 entities in one action.

schedule_unknown_entity.message: One of the entities does not exist.

schedule_not_schedulable.message: Only lights, switches, fans, input booleans, media players, climate, humidifiers, sirens and covers can be scheduled.

schedule_too_far.message: An action is set at most a year ahead.

schedule_off_with_end.message: An end or a brightness goes with switching on, not off.

schedule_end_before_start.message: The end comes before the start.

schedule_too_long.message: A device is left on at most a week.

schedule_too_many.message: 100 actions are already waiting: cancel some first.

schedule_not_allowed.message: You may not control one of these devices.
